beaches.name: Delavoyas
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported to the right of a rocky outcrop, south of Batsi. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2006 to 2023 and calls it the locally known nudist beach; an August 2024 report found only clothed bathers. No designation or signage is documented.

beaches.name: Lydi
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported across this small beach south of Andros Town. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2018 and 2024, both describing everyone present as nude. No designation or signage is documented.
